name: Mordenhalden
description: An old wizard in a blue robe whose knotty staff lights the way through mountain fog.
biography:
Mordenhalden learned magic keeping the lamps on a mountain road. When a landslide buried the upper watchpost, he pried its signal glass from the wreckage and set it into the fork of his walking staff. Blue light carried through the fog. Yellow marked the last stretch of road the rescuers could cross on foot. By morning, every traveler sheltering above the slide was accounted for.

He still walks the road after the first snow. He mends the frayed edges of his blue robe with white thread from the tollhouse sewing tin and wears wool socks under his sandals. A few tarnished rings sit on his fingers. Corked bottles of amber, teal, and violet potions hang from his belt alongside a leather pouch and the brass keys to the watchposts. When the fog is thick enough to hide the next milestone, he waits there with his staff lit until the last traveler comes through.
